Stack: Django, Python, Requests, PostgreSQL. Live: https://edutoolshub.onrender.com
- https://portfolio.allkvd.dev/#projects — **SociaSphere (Distributed Feed Optimization Engine & Session Service)**: Session authentication with JWT handling, reducing feed query complexity from O(N) relational round-trips to O(1) single-query execution via ORM prefetching and database annotations. Stack: Django, Python, PostgreSQL. Live: https://sociasphere.onrender.com

## Open Source Contributions

- https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp — **Prefect FastMCP (25k+ GitHub Stars)**: Upstream contributions to Prefect's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Python framework:
  1. PR #3736: Patched asynchronous lifecycle state leak by dynamically provisioning a fresh session manager per runtime cycle, eliminating thread task-group failures in multi-run test suites.
  2. PR #3750: Hardened token validation pipelines using thread-safe deep-copy model replication to propagate upstream identity claims across service boundaries without cross-request state pollution.
  3. PR #3768: Resolved OpenAPI-to-JSON Schema mismatch by intercepting nullable flags and injecting null parameters into enum constraints.
